document.abstract: Peter Swinson of Cintel International provides some answers to a question that is affecting more and more program makers who are faced with multiple choices in the HD field. The question posed in the title is often asked. The following article attempts to explain the relevant issues, including the alternative of scanning direct to data.

authors.bio: After many years with Cintel, Peter Swinson has now formed an independent consulting company, and offers his considerable experience and expertise of the film industry to companies throughout the world. Swinson will be presenting the BKSTS Bernard Happé Memorial lecture on November 24, 2004. Contact details: 114 Cambridge Road, St Albans, Herts AL1 5LG;Tel: 01727 830468; Mobile: 0781 084 7436.
